camera_policy: RGB-only fixture estimates supplied to a NEW conditioned DA3 inference. Input K_index is converted once to K_edge for upstream resize, returned K_edge once to native K_index for backprojection. Reconstruct rods using the exact exported cameras lifted to original RGB coordinates.
upstream_policy: Observe raw model cameras/depth before the documented API camera replacement and depth scale division. Returned input poses are not a learned pose accuracy result. The upstream encoder ignores principal point; retain and report the supplied off-center offset, without claiming the network encodes it.
point_policy: All finite positive newly predicted depth pixels, no confidence pruning. Immutable full point snapshot, no suppression. Two separate finite-curve patches, saved enabled/withdrawn views and exact rollback checks.
readout_policy: Existing abstaining reader unchanged, two previous camera-span scales. The same declared RGB strips, origin, thresholds and complete points+segments input apply to base and both candidates. No candidate-only curve scoring as a substitute for complete-candidate readout.
evaluation_policy: 18 paired readout rows: 3 cases x 2 scales x base/baseline/cylinder. Preserve empty/unmeasurable results, direct fixture-world physical metrics, no GT alignment or post-score tuning. Existing reader remains a development diagnostic, not newly qualified by this run.
scope: New same-source depth/camera and reversible point+curve integration on three known synthetic development objects. No real photos, dense surface repair or G1 qualification.
